# Processes

A process is a sequence of verbs and decisions. Each process is one file. Read a process when it is run. A process's card names its steps in order, says which steps are gates, and says whether the process may run unattended. A gate is a step that needs the Human Lead's yes. A step that is not a gate runs without asking.

A process's name is one word, as in plan. The Human Lead starts a process by its name.

The Space's own processes are files in this folder, beside the two folders below, and each has a line here. An own file with the same name as a file in `default/` is used instead of that default. The verb process-add writes a new process.

- [core/](./core/index.md): empty, because no process is core.
- [default/](./default/index.md): the processes that ship with AI-Lore and that the Space may replace.
